snippet.title: Weekend Warrior (1996) Full Playthrough
snippet.description: Full walkthrough of the 1996 classic, Weekend Warrior, on the iMac. This is a beautiful game that does not deserve to have fallen into obscurity like it has. Share this video if you want this game to come back!
